import pandas as pd
import os

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)

# Read input file
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
non_indicator_cols = {"city_id", "city_name", "year"}
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in non_indicator_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missingness_report = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = 1 if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 0
    missingness_report.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": missing_count,
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_report)

# Write missingness report
report_path = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
report_df.to_csv(report_path, index=False)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = [row["indicator"] for row in missingness_report if row["kept"] == 1]

# Build selected matrix: city_id, city_name, year, and kept indicators
selected_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_cols]

# Write selected matrix
selected_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
selected_df.to_csv(selected_path, index=False)
</solution_file>
